items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 17 at 2:39PM EDT until October 19 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Gale Warning, north winds 20 to 30 knots with
gusts up to 35 knots and seas 9 to 14 feet. For the Small
Craft Advisory, northeast winds 20 to 25 knots with gusts up
to 30 knots and seas 9 to 14 feet expected.

* WHERE...Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm
and Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 20-60 nm.

* WHEN...For the Gale Warning, until 2 AM EDT Monday. For the
Small Craft Advisory, from 2 AM Monday to 1 AM EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
